title: Question quality report v1
description: `reports/<product>_question_quality.json`, written by `eval questions analyze` (dokimi.questions.quality_analyzer): a model's difficulty and triviality label for each question, and the distribution over the set.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

diversity_score.description: Normalized entropy over the difficulty buckets: 0 all one, 1 balanced.

difficulty.description: As the model replied; beginner, intermediate or advanced when it followed the prompt. A reply that is not text, or a failed call, reads as intermediate with `error` set.

error.description: Why the call failed, or that the reply's difficulty was not text.
